newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY O/N RATES PLUMMET TO 18 PCT.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY O/N RATES PLUMMET TO 18 PCT.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed lower in abundant liquidity on the last day of the two-week reserve period, dealers said.
Overnight rates closed at 18 percent, below the opening rate of 19 percent and compared to Wednesday's end of 20 percent.
"Banks have put what remains of excess money above reserve needs into the one-day reverse repo facility," said Karoly Barath of Postabank.
Banks had little alternative but to use the short-term repo facility as in the next reserve period, which starts on Friday, they may need funds again, Barath said.
The one-week reverse repo rate is 17.50 percent.
Dealers expected the overnight rates to rebound on Friday to around 22.75 to 23 percent.
